svg.aria-label: Production architecture I run: clients through HAProxy and NGINX ingress into a k3s cluster with FastAPI, WebSocket gateway and Celery workers, backed by PostgreSQL with PgBouncer, Redis, RabbitMQ and MinIO on Longhorn volumes; GitHub Actions and Helm for delivery; Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and Alertmanager for observability.
svg.text: // what I build & run in production
